# Questions — hammurabi-laws-178-184 (drafter; what I decided meanwhile)

1. **Which classes of woman are NIN.AN, SAL, zikrum, kallātim, qadištum, NU.PAR, aššat Marduk, šugītum?** The code lists them without defining them. Decided: NIN.AN = ugbabtum (UNCERTAIN, as §127); the SAL after it = Harper's ŠAL(?), given as the bare sign with no class name; `zi-ik-ru-um` = a class "zikrum" (its own lemma, not the prologue's zikrum "name"); `{šal}É.GI₄.A` = kallātim, a class (the word is "bride" at §153–169), UNCERTAIN; `{šal}NU.GIG` = qadištum; NU.PAR left as two signs; SAL + {d}AMAR.UTU = aššat Marduk "a wife of Marduk". I did not use the modern class names (nadītum etc.) anywhere. If the owner wants the later-editions names given, they go in the notes only.
2. **ŠAL(?) after NIN.AN (XXX 61, XXXI 20).** Harper's question mark. Decided: SAL, lemma "SAL-sign", no gloss beyond "a woman-sign Harper could not place". Alternative: read it with NIN.AN as one title (ŠAL.NIN.AN as at §108 would be the reverse order, so not done).
3. **šim as TAG.** Harper writes -šim in one piece at XXX 85 and XXXII 19 and the plate shows one TAG-shaped sign. Decided: glyph TAG with tr "šim" so that the reading keeps Harper's value; the sign glossary lists only šum for TAG. Alternative: tr "šum", say išruqšim, reading iš-ru-uq-šum.
4. **iš-[ru]-uq-ši-im (XXXI 48).** Harper brackets RU; no RU on the plate. Decided: glyph RU, tr "[ru]", with the note. Alternative: omit the glyph.
5. **zinništi (XXXI 21, 46).** Harper's genitive. Decided: say zinništum at §179 (subject, SAL shows no ending), zinništim at §180 (apposition after mārtišu kallātim).
6. **ì-kal (XXXI 13) vs i-ik-ka-al (XXXI 57, 73).** The plate has NI + KAL at 13; Harper normalized i-kal. Decided: glyphs NI (tr ì) + KAL, say ikkal.
7. **šarāqum "to give" vs šarāqum "to steal".** The published glossary has only "to steal (išriq)". Decided: new lemma šarāqum-give for išruq(-), išarraq-; šeriqtum stays. If the reviewer thinks it is one verb, rename in units.json and broaden the glossary entry.
8. **ušamziši / uštamziši.** Š-stem of an unidentified verb (m-z-ʾ?). Decided: lemma mazûm-Š marked UNCERTAIN, "let her have as much as her heart wants". Alternative: leave untranslated.
9. **uppal (XXXI 17).** Taken from apālum "to pay"; "nor use them to pay another (?)". UNCERTAIN.
10. **ŠE.BA, Ì.BA (Harper NI.BA), SIG.BA (Harper ŠIG.BA).** Left unread; "grain, oil and wool rations" is the customary sense. Reading Ì for the NI sign follows ŠE.GIŠ.Ì at §42–51.
11. **IGI.3.GAL.** Said šalšat (a reconstruction, (?)); three glyphs with THREE as role num.
12. **mārtišu.** The plate shows DUMU.SAL-šu with a ŠU-like last sign; 153-169 has DUMU.SAL-zu for mārassu. Decided: Harper's šu. A global ŠU/ZU check across the code is outside this part.
13. **ilkam ul illak (§182).** "She shall not perform the fief-duty"; the reason (her third carries no service) is my inference, marked UNCERTAIN in the note.
14. **TIM vs DIM** in -tim words: TIM throughout (as 153-177).
